narr: Strong to severe thunderstorms moved northward through Southeastern Arizona the afternoon and evening of July 2nd, 2025. These storms caused severe wind gusts and thunderstorm wind damage causing power outages due to downed power lines and damage to equipment. Additionally, there was heavy rainfall causing flash flooding of roughly 3 feet of water moving through a low water crossing.
ev: An estimated 3 ft of water moved across low water crossing on Forest Service 143 Rd.
lsr: Delayed report. Water 3 ft deep at LWC with Forest Service 143 Rd., 0.3 miles ESE of IJ Bar Ranch buildings.
